claims.statement: Thailand Privilege Bronze costs 650,000 THB for 5 years (0 points) and Gold costs 900,000 THB for 5 years (20 points/year).

The BOI LTR visa costs 50,000 THB upon approval for a 10-year renewable stay (5+5 years) with 1-year reporting and requires USD 80,000/year income (or USD 40,000 with a master's degree) plus an eligible public or USD 50M-revenue employer for remote workers.

Thailand Retirement visas (50+) require 800,000 THB in a Thai bank account (with a 400,000 THB minimum balance rule) or 65,000 THB monthly income, prohibit work, and require 3,000,000 THB health insurance on the Non-O-A route.
